description: NexaMusic 0.1.2 — refreshed interface, lyrics improvements, and automatic updates.

changelog.title: What's new
items: Refreshed the Search screen with a black background and Apple Music-inspired red accents.
Improved Search category tiles, selection states, and animations while keeping existing search behaviour.
Refined Settings screen grouping, layout, and appearance.
Added automatic update checks every six hours, with support for stable and beta releases.
Added automatic update downloads when an eligible update is found; Android still asks for approval before installation.
Improved lyrics rendering performance and reduced excessive glow.
Added Flamingo as a named option in the Lyrics Style selector.
Improved the Lyrics Style live preview.

changelog.title: Notes
items: Some playback interruptions and lyric timing issues may still occur on certain devices or accounts.
Playlist synchronization and album loading improvements should be verified with a signed-in YouTube Music account.
